therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: DNA damage repair pathway inhibition to enhance radiation sensitivity
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Metastatic invasive carcinoma of the cervix
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Maximum tolerated dose and local progression-free survival

results.effect_size: Median local PFS not reached (no patients had progression)
safety_signals: 2 of 3 patients experienced dose-limiting toxicities at 100mg dose
results.dose_information: 100mg daily concurrent with radiation therapy, dose escalation planned but study terminated early
